title: Raft uncommitted log entry overwrite during multi-candidate split-vote term change
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0209: Raft uncommitted log entry overwrite during multi-candidate split-vote term change
Repository: `etcd-io/etcd`
Category: `Distributed Consensus & Partitioning`
Target File: `raft/consensus.go`

#### Problem Description
Candidate receives higher term AppendEntries while processing RequestVote RPC, overwriting uncommitted log index.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Reject AppendEntries if term < currentTerm or if prevLogIndex entry term does not match committed term.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0209.py -q`
expected_invariant: Reject AppendEntries if term < currentTerm or if prevLogIndex entry term does not match committed term.
